description: This file defines interfaces related to the lifecycle management of grains in Orleans, including migration, dehydration, and rehydration contexts.

methods.name: AddMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Registers a grain migration participant to the lifecycle.

methods.name: RemoveMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Unregisters a grain migration participant from the lifecycle.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Called on the original activation when migration is initiated; allows participant to access and update dehydration context.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Called on the new activation after migration; allows participant to restore state from rehydration context.

methods.name: Keys
methods.description: Gets the keys in the dehydration or rehydration context.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds a sequence of bytes to the dehydration context, associated with a key.

methods.name: AddBytes<T>
methods.description: Adds a value to the dehydration context by serializing it with a provided writer delegate.

methods.name: TryAddValue
methods.description: Attempts to add a value to the dehydration context, serializing it if possible.

methods.name: TryGetBytes
methods.description: Tries to retrieve a sequence of bytes from the rehydration context associated with a key.

methods.name: TryGetValue<T>
methods.description: Tries to retrieve and deserialize a value from the rehydration context associated with a key.
